description: List L2 coded claim-cards (claim + optional quote + chunk_index + lens + codes + start_seconds? + url). Filter by project_id, interview_id / interview_ids, codes (any match), or lens (workflow|gtm|privacy|other). CITATION REQUIRED: actively cite each card.quote to the user as markdown ["verbatim quote"]({base_url}/project/interview/{id}?t={seconds}) using item.url from the tool result (already absolute; includes ?t= when start_seconds is set). Prefer quotes over paraphrase. Verify with interviews_read action=transcript around_chunk_index when a wider quote window is needed.

codes.description: Optional code tags; any match (e.g. pain:synthesis, gtm:pricing).

interview_id.description: Optional interview UUID to scope cards.

interview_ids.description: Optional interview UUIDs to scope cards.

project_id.description: Optional project UUID — cards from interviews in this project (alias: folder_id).
